scope_notes: freeze_dataset first rejects status invalid, then requires source_registration_sha256 provenance, then enforces counts/fingerprint. Its reproduction only passes roles,prior_regression,expected_regression_fingerprint, with no waiver mapping/SHA. extract_registration accepts exact waiver but no preregistered row-filter policy. Exact reproduced manifest comparison makes filtered/waiver candidates non-freezeable without integration work.

Source token/BOS/target/model/length checks are data checks, not optimizer forward/backward or runtime zero-State injection smoke. normalize_row itself does not establish zero profile; source profile inspection is separate.
execute0 plus preregistered required_coverage=false is a real data gate; Agent Strict0 or incomplete final tasks are not the gate. No training or data version creation is justified by this review.

Prior-regression triple pins apply when reusing a valid fixed regression. Code explicitly allows prior=None for initial freeze when regression_reused=false; absence of an already-published prior must not become a separate circular prohibition on first freeze. A candidate regression fingerprint and valid quality gates still required.

FINAL_GATE zero_source_profiles_and_tokenizer_verified=false is conservative as final normalization was not established, but raw source metadata for all final20 does say zero and matching tokenizer. Do not confuse this with optimizer attestation.
